subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Use Case Testing
description: Learn Use Case Testing in one minute.

hook.text: A user logs in, searches for a product, adds it to cart, and checks out. That's one use case with many steps.

buildup.text: Use case testing follows realistic user scenarios end-to-end, verifying the whole flow works together.

discovery.text: It tests both the happy path and alternate paths—what if payment fails? What if the item sells out mid-cart?

twist.text: Use cases catch integration bugs that unit tests miss because they exercise multiple components together.

climax.text: Business stakeholders understand use cases intuitively, making them ideal for validating real-world requirements.

punchline.text: Test like the user acts. Use cases mirror real behavior.

quiz.question: What makes use case testing different from unit testing?
options: It follows realistic end-to-end user scenarios
